notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent with toughness 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
